6. Risks / edge cases / conflicts
- The remaining source docs are heterogeneous:
  - `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-05-29.md` and `...2026-06-04.md` explicitly say “No SAFE_TO_MERGE findings in this pass.”
  - `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-06-05.md` is narrative and ends with “If you want, I can turn this into a commit-ready markdown report file...”, not a formal handoff block.
  - `...2026-06-05-2.md` also relies on narrative prioritized-action prose rather than a clean handoff section.
  - `...2026-06-05-3.md` and `...2026-06-06-2.md` expose only minimal handoff IDs.
  This means the implementer must translate recommendation prose into the report taxonomy instead of relying only on `SAFE_TO_MERGE` markers.
- The existing report does not currently use literal `VALID-BUT-RISKY` / `STALE-OR-ALREADY-DONE` headings; its established equivalents are `Implemented by sibling work`, `Already satisfied on this ref`, and `Intentionally deferred`. Keep that wording unless an explicit invalid bucket is actually needed.
- Several late-May/June docs overlap on the same themes (`review_autofix`, CI contract regressions, validate observability, prompt/cache telemetry). Each doc still needs its own section; avoid collapsing multiple source docs into one shared section.
- This issue is cleanup only. If a recommendation is still attractive but unimplemented, record that status; do not broaden scope into new code changes here.

7. Testing / verification considerations
- Confirm `analysis/recommendation-processing-report.md` now includes sections for all eight docs and the processed-doc count/list is updated to `93`.
- Confirm none of the eight filenames were already present in the report before this pass; they are new append-only entries.
- Confirm only the scoped files changed: one report edit plus eight deletions.
- Confirm `analysis/last_collection_timestamp.txt`, `analysis/validation-selftest-status.json`, and every `analysis/recommendation-processing-report*.md` file still exist unchanged except for the intended report append.
- After deletion, `analysis/` should retain the report plus the two protected state files, not the eight source docs.
- No code test/lint/build run is necessary unless the implementation accidentally drifts outside markdown-only scope.
